title: SMOK Novo Master Box Leather Pod Kit
description:
The
SMOK Novo Master Box Leather Pod Kit
is a compact, box-style refillable pod system with a leather-textured finish. Features a 1000mAh battery, dual power modes (Standard and 30W Boost), and stepless airflow control. Backwards compatible with older Novo pods.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1000mAh
Charging:
USB Type-C (1.4A Fast Charging)
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL
Power Modes:
Standard (22.8W) / Boost (30W)
Coil Resistance:
Integrated Mesh (0.6Ω and 0.8Ω pods included)
Activation:
Draw-Activated
Airflow:
Stepless Adjustable
Pod Compatibility:
Novo Master Pods, Novo 2X Pods, Novo 2 Pods, Novo 3 Pods
Kit Contents:
1× Novo Master Box Device, 1× 0.8Ω Meshed Pod (pre-installed), 1× 0.6Ω Meshed Pod, 1× Lanyard, 1× USB-C Cable
Brand:
SMOK
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nicotine e-liquid for best results.
Available options: Cyan, White.
